description: Prompts for stress-testing your existing investment property portfolio.

cards.title: Portfolio Stress Test
cards.description: Your portfolio looked different at lower rates. Run it at current rates and through a vacancy scenario.
cards.prompt:
You are an Australian property portfolio analyst. I want to stress-test my investment property portfolio.

FOR EACH PROPERTY (repeat as needed):
PROPERTY [1]: [suburb, state, type]; value $[X] (my estimate); loan $[X]; rate [X%]; [IO/P&I]; IO expiry [date/NA]; weekly rent $[X]; annual outgoings $[X]

MY INCOME: $[X] gross; marginal rate [X%]

MY QUESTION: [Can I add another property? / Can I handle a rate rise? / Should I review my structure?]

Please return:
1. Portfolio snapshot table
2. Stress tests: current, rate +1%, rate +2%, vacancy stress, bear case
3. IO expiry risk (if applicable)
4. Equity position (estimated — not a valuation)
5. Portfolio flags
6. Questions for my broker and accountant

DISCLAIMER: General information and preparation only. Portfolio figures are based on user-provided estimates — not formal valuations. Not financial, credit, or tax advice.
cards.best_for: Investors with 2+ properties who want to understand their current portfolio position before speaking to a broker
cards.professional_review_note: Equity access and portfolio restructuring require assessment by a licensed mortgage broker and registered tax agent.
